gallery.title: File:Berlin - Kunsthaus Tacheles.jpg
gallery.description: Mitte. Oranienburgerstraße The Kunsthaus Tacheles (Art House Tacheles) was an art center in Berlin. Serving as a Nazi prison for a short while, it was later partially demolished. After the Berlin Wall had come down, it was taken over by artists, who called it Tacheles, Yiddish for "straight talking". On September 4, 2012, the remaining 40-60 artists left peacefully, after pressure from the owner - after 22 years. In 2016, the building was still closed and empty.

gallery.title: File:Berlin ehem.Tacheles (42170211562).jpg
gallery.description: Berlin-Mitte in der Friedrichstraße, ehemaliges Tacheles. Blick in die Gebäudelücke der Nr. 112 und 110, wo schon die ersten Arbeiten für das 'Stadtquartier' 'Am Tacheles' im Gange sind. Dieses wird später bis an das Tacheles heranreichen, welches das Gebäude im Hintergrund, im mittleren Bereich des Bildes ist.

gallery.description: Gorilla sculpture made of scrap metal. Title: "König Karl der Gorilla" (2012). Sculptor: Steven Studinski (Tacheles). Once stood in front of Batman Elektronik, Hermannstraße 211, Berlin-Neukölln. Moved to in front of Hauptstraße 162, Berlin-Schöneberg after Batman Elektronic went out of business.
